answer: An adversary running 39 aliases thus needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in anchor, expire in ledge, and orchard lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 665 identities would post 618 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
